note: What people must sign off before the exhibit opens, and whether they have. Each is accepted in the staff review app by the person responsible, under their own name; an entry counts as signed only with who accepted it, the date, and a reference to the decision (the review app's own reference, or a signed record in data/curation-decisions/). `section` names the part of docs/sign-off.md the person confirms; `asks` is a question the acceptance must answer; `requires` lists sign-offs that must be signed first. npm run readiness only reads this file.
